mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_number, template_id, event_type, status, retry_at, attempts, worker_id, lease_until, last_error, create_time, update_time FROM t_coupon_template_outbox WHERE (status = 'NEW' OR (status = 'RETRY' AND retry_at <= #{now})) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_coupon_template_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_number = #{shopNumber} AND status IN ('NEW', 'RETRY')

UPDATE t_coupon_template_outbox SET status = 'RETRY', retry_at = #{retryAt}, attempts = #{attempts}, last_error = #{lastError}, worker_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_number = #{shopNumber} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND worker_id = #{workerId}
